evidence.source: Local package verification, SSH x570, SSH vps-tencent-tokyo, public HTTPS/WSS, Cloudflare DNS API, and Let's Encrypt staging/production
evidence.verification: Verified 26 Vitest tests, 24 Python VPS tests with only two local-image skips covered by the VPS production-image canary, typecheck/build, shell/Python syntax, package contents and diff check. Deployed one wildcard certificate and registry Hub with backup receipt 20260817T173009Z; Nginx validates; Hub status is configured; x570 socket is present and secure. Public token exchange, authenticated HTTP and real /api/events.mux WebSocket succeeded. x570 stop produced registered 503 while unknown remained 404 and zsh remained 200; recovery returned x570 to 200. Rotation closed the old WebSocket, made the old cookie return 401 on a protected path, and allowed a new session/WebSocket. Wildcard renewal dry-run passed. No credential values were emitted.
evidence.valid_when: The package artifact, deployed Nginx/Compose/registry/routes identities, wildcard certificate lineage, x570 service/profile/state, DNS target, and existing zsh service remain at the recorded identities and health states.
evidence.invalid_when: Any package or deployed configuration identity changes, x570 is re-registered or its token rotates again, the wildcard certificate lineage changes, or either public endpoint loses the recorded behavior.
evidence.reuse_scope: WI-HUB-DELIVERY acceptance and alignment, convergence identity, independent review, final E2E, recovery receipt, and closeout.
